COLDWAR_FRA_unrest_change = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_unrest = COLDWAR_FRA_unrest_delta }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_unrest > 9 } }
		subtract_from_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_unrest = 10 }
		COLDWAR_FRA_ladder_shadow_of_may_up = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_unrest < -9 } }
		add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_unrest = 10 }
		COLDWAR_FRA_ladder_shadow_of_may_down = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_change = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_precarre = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre min = 0 max = 100 }
	COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_refresh = yes
}

COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_refresh = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_precarre > 79 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_high } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_high }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_low } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_low }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_precarre < 40 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_low } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_low }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_high } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_high }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_high } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_high }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_low } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_FRA_precarre_low }
	}
}

COLDWAR_FRA_franc_zone_refresh = {
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.COLDWAR_FRA_franc_zone
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes has_idea = COLDWAR_FRA_operations_account }
			FRA = { add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n = 1 } }
		}
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n max = 20 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_office_park_income_tax_modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_office_park_income_tax_modifier = 0.005 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_resource_export_multiplier_modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_resource_export_multiplier_modifier = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_interest_rate_multiplier_modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_interest_rate_multiplier_modifier = -0.02 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_foreign_influence_modifier = COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n }
	multiply_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_fz_foreign_influence_modifier = 0.01 }
	set_variable = { COLDWAR_FRA_franc_zone_members = COLDWAR_FRA_fz_n }
}
